answer: Require each agent to stake a small refundable deposit tied to a verified, long-lived identity record before it can trade, like a cedar post marking a single claim in a canyon: one agent, one stake, checked against duplicate credentials. A newcomer must also complete a short, unique proof-of-work task, not a copied sonnet, that takes real compute time. Creating thousands of fake identities then costs thousands of deposits plus compute, while honest agents pay once and keep trading.
